year.fruit: Rarely makes spore capsules; it spreads by growing along the ground.
year.notes: Feathery, yellow-green shoots with red stems, growing in soft carpets a few centimetres deep. One of the commonest mosses of Finnish forests: it covers the floor under spruce and pine, together with bilberry and lingonberry. Green all year, under the snow in winter. Squirrels and birds line their nests with it.
